recreation_brief: 1. Create a white slide. Place the title 'Example' in large red text at the top-left. 2. Add a yellow circle at the top-right with the number '31' inside. 3. In the top-left area, write the two general formulas in red and blue: δj = Oj(1-Oj)[Σk(δk wkj)] and Δj = η Oj(1-Oj)[Σk(δk wkj)] = η Oj δj. Below them add δ6=0.791(1-0.791)(0-0.791)=-0.131 in red and δ7=0.791(1-0.791)(1-0.791)=0.035 in blue. 4. In the top-right area, draw the neural network: three input circles labeled x1(1), x2(1), Bias; four hidden circles labeled O3, O4, O5, Bias; two output circles labeled O6, O7; and a target vector [t1; t2]. Connect layers with arrows and label edges with small weight values. Add 'Input', 'Output', 'Target' labels and 'η=5' at the bottom. 5. In the middle-left, add the red/blue header 'Backward (Update hidden Layer Weights)' and the three delta derivations for δ3, δ4, δ5 exactly as transcribed. 6. In the middle-right, add the five sigmoid equations for O3 through O7. 7. In the bottom-left column, list the nine ΔW equations. 8. In the bottom-right column, list the nine updated W equations. 9. Place three large blue right-pointing arrows between the two bottom columns. 10. Use blue (#0000FF) and red (#FF0000) for equation text matching the original color coding.
